sections.title: Sound / Sounds
sections.text:
Sound ck click.
Click, click, Jack clicks the mouse of his computer.
Suddenly, the computer screen goes black.
Check, check, Jack checks the system of his computer.
Luckily, the desktop comes back.

sections.title: Talking time
sections.text:
Interesting facts about computers
The earliest electronic computer was huge. It was as big as a room and as heavy as four elephants. It had no mouse or keyboard.
Today, computers can be very small. Microchips can be as small as a grain of salt.
Scientists used the earliest computers to work out difficult maths problems. Today, students use computers to study, search for information, send emails and do many other things.
Find the rule: It was as big as a room. It was as heavy as four elephants. They were as small as a grain of salt.
What will computers be like in the future?

sections.title: Reading time
sections.text:
Got a problem? Ask Simon!
Dear Simon, I’ve got a new computer as a gift from my grandpa. My little brother often turns on my computer and messes up my files. It’s really bad. What should I do? From Star 88.
Hi Star 88! You need to set a power-on password. You can set a password by using eight different letters, numbers and symbols. Keep it to yourself and don’t tell others. Good luck. Simon.
Dear Simon, I carelessly dropped some milk on the desktop keyboard. Now my keyboard does not work. I am worried. Is my computer broken? I don’t know what to do. Please help me! From Lightning 99.
Hi Lightning 99! A little milk on the keyboard does not matter too much. Clean the keyboard first. And leave it to dry. If you are worried, you can ask parents to help you check the computer. Remember, do not drink milk or other drinks while using the computer in the future. Simon.
For a slow computer: Close unused programs. Restart your computer. Delete unnecessary files. Check for viruses. Update your computer.

sections.note: 教材项目页，无独立配套音轨
sections.text:
My computer quiz
Think about your statements. Write them down. Add the answers in the corner. Share your quiz with your friends.
Statements can be true or false. Example: Heat is a computer’s enemy. A laptop should be used on a person’s lap. It’s safe to use your birth date to create your password. When you delete a file, it usually moves to the computer’s Recycle Bin.
